requirements.title: TRAILZ counts trailing zero bits
requirements.definition: For an integer with all bits zero, TRAILZ returns BIT_SIZE(I); otherwise it returns the position of the rightmost one bit in the bit sequence of I.

pending.TRAILZ-all-zero-bits-BIT_SIZE: For default integer and k18=SELECTED_INT_KIND(18) integer controls, initialize result sentinels to -1, assert TRAILZ(0)==BIT_SIZE(0) and TRAILZ(0_k18)==BIT_SIZE(0_k18), then pair with middle-bit nonzero cases in the same two kinds so the all-zero result is not vacuous. SELECTED_INT_KIND(18) is guaranteed by 7.4.3.1 p2.
pending.TRAILZ-rightmost-one-bit-position: For default integer and k18 controls, construct middle-bit values from zero using IBSET at positions 3 and 5, assert BTEST for both set bits, then assert TRAILZ returns 3 in each kind. Mutate the lower IBSET position to 2 so the finite count differs.
pending.TRAILZ-leftmost-one-bit-position: For default integer and k18 controls, construct I=IBSET(0_k, BIT_SIZE(0_k)-1), observe the leftmost set bit only with BTEST(I, BIT_SIZE(I)-1), and assert TRAILZ(I)==BIT_SIZE(I)-1. This observes the bit result in bit context and never relies on the processor-dependent numeric interpretation of a leftmost-bit-set integer. Mutate the bit position to BIT_SIZE(0_k)-2.
pending.TRAILZ-negative-bit-pattern-position-zer: Use J=NOT(0) to obtain an all-one bit pattern without relying on its numeric interpretation; assert BTEST(J,0) and TRAILZ(J)==0. Mutate J to ISHFT(J,1) or to IBCLR(J,0) so the finite count differs.
